rationale: A is more useful because it compares all three live options across multiple decision-relevant dimensions, ties those dimensions to the stated goals of speed and accuracy, and gives more concrete implementation guidance (central core, embedded support, escalation rule, sync cadence). It also handles contingencies better by noting when embedded or centralized could be preferable depending on policy ambiguity, team maturity, and rework cost. B is solid and concise, but less discriminative and less nuanced about tradeoffs. Neither provides real quantitative analysis, though A’s structured comparison is somewhat stronger.
